Checking where `property.title` is used in the web layer and how snippets drive list previews.

Also checking memo batch helpers for rebuild triggers.

Checking `useMemoFilters` to determine whether property filters run server-side or client-side.

Tags are derived metadata from content via ExtractAll. Persisted derived fields include `property` flags, `title`, and `tags`. `snippet` is computed on read via GenerateSnippet. Verifying tag output-only status.

Also investigating whether `memo_mention_helpers` derives metadata from plan documents. Re-examining the memo payload proto for mention-related fields.
Checking whether `memopayload.RunOnce` is actually invoked from `server.go`, since it appears only in `runner.go`.
Checking whether preview metadata is computed client-side or entirely server-side.

The repository inspection is complete. I am ready to report the exact computation sites, recomputation triggers, and extracted properties.

Two tiers of derived metadata were identified.

Tier 1 persists in `memo.Payload` and recomputes on content changes via `RebuildMemoPayload`. It extracts `tags` from markdown `#tag` syntax and `property` flags including `has_link`, `has_task_list`, `has_code`, `has_incomplete_tasks`, and `title` from the first H1 heading.

Tier 2 is computed at API response time and not stored. It produces `snippet` as a plain-text summary capped at 64 characters via `GenerateSnippet`.

The primary computation site is `internal/markdown/markdown.go`, specifically `ExtractAll()`, `ExtractProperties()`, and `GenerateSnippet()`.

`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go` orchestrates `RebuildMemoPayload()`, which invokes `ExtractAll()`.

`r/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go` calls `GenerateSnippet(content, 64)` to produce the snippet.

Persisted metadata recomputes on `CreateMemo` at line 108 of `memo_service.go` and on `UpdateMemo` when the update mask includes `content` at line 447. `CreateMemoComment` triggers indirect recomputation through `CreateMemo`. A batch rebuild utility exists in `memopayload.Runner.RunOnce()`, but it is not yet wired into server startup.

Snippet generation also occurs on every API conversion inside `convertMemoFromStore` at lines 76–80. Relations and notifications compute snippets on demand.

The frontend consumes these fields for lists and previews. `property.hasLink`, `hasTaskList`, and `hasCode` drive filters in `useMemoFilters`. `snippet` powers `MemoSnippetLink`, `MemoDetailSidebar`, and comment list views. Tags from the payload support tag filtering.

`memopayload.RunOnce` is not registered in server startup and appears to be manual-only.

Mentions extracted by `ExtractAll` are not persisted in `memo.Payload`; they are used only for notifications. The `property.title` field is not consumed by the frontend. `snippet` is recomputed on every read rather than only when content changes.

## Derived memo metadata (content-computed, not user-set)

This repo (Memos) derives metadata from markdown content in two ways: **persisted payload fields** (rebuilt on write) and **response-time fields** (recomputed on read).

---

### 1. Computation sites

| Layer | File | Role |
|-------|------|------|
| **Core parser** | `internal/markdown/markdown.go` | Parses markdown (goldmark) and extracts metadata |
| **Persist orchestration** | `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go` | Calls `ExtractAll` and writes into `memo.Payload` |
| **Snippet (read path)** | `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go` | Calls `GenerateSnippet` when building API responses |
| **API mapping** | `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_converter.go` | Maps stored `property`/`tags`; adds `snippet` per memo |

**Primary logic** — AST walk in `ExtractAll` / `ExtractProperties`:

```192:240:internal/markdown/markdown.go
// ExtractProperties computes boolean properties about the content.
func (s *service) ExtractProperties(content []byte) (*storepb.MemoPayload_Property, error) {
	// ...
		switch n.Kind() {
		case gast.KindLink:
			prop.HasLink = true
		case gast.KindCodeBlock, gast.KindFencedCodeBlock, gast.KindCodeSpan:
			prop.HasCode = true
		case east.KindTaskCheckBox:
			prop.HasTaskList = true
			if checkBox, ok := n.(*east.TaskCheckBox); ok {
				if !checkBox.IsChecked {
					prop.HasIncompleteTasks = true
				}
			}
		// ...
```

**Persist hook**:

```74:87:server/runner/memopayload/runner.go
func RebuildMemoPayload(_ context.Context, memo *store.Memo, markdownService markdown.Service) error {
	// ...
	data, err := markdownService.ExtractAll([]byte(memo.Content))
	// ...
	memo.Payload.Tags = data.Tags
	memo.Payload.Property = data.Property
	return nil
}
```

**Snippet hook** (64-char plain-text preview):

```83:89:server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go
func (s *APIV1Service) getMemoContentSnippet(content string) (string, error) {
	snippet, err := s.MarkdownService.GenerateSnippet([]byte(content), 64)
	// ...
}
```

Schema definitions: `proto/store/memo.proto:14-22`, `proto/api/v1/memo_service.proto:255-278`.

---

### 2. Operations that trigger recomputation

**Persisted fields (`tags`, `property`)** — only when content changes:

| Operation | Trigger | Evidence |
|-----------|---------|----------|
| **CreateMemo** | Always | `memo_service.go:108` → `RebuildMemoPayload` |
| **UpdateMemo** | Only if `update_mask` includes `"content"` | `memo_service.go:436-451` |
| **CreateMemoComment** | Indirectly via `CreateMemo` | `memo_service_comments.go:56-59` |
| **Batch rebuild** | `memopayload.Runner.RunOnce()` | `runner.go:27-72` — **exists but is not wired into server startup** (`server/server.go` only starts `s3presign`) |

Updates to visibility, pinned, location, attachments, etc. do **not** rebuild payload unless `content` is also in the mask.

**Snippet** — recomputed on **every API conversion**, not stored:

- `convertMemoFromStore` → `getMemoContentSnippet` (`memo_service_converter.go:76-80`)
- Also for relation snippets, notifications, webhooks

---

### 3. Properties extracted

**Persisted in `MemoPayload` (via `ExtractAll`):**

| Field | Source |
|-------|--------|
| `tags[]` | `#tag` tokens in markdown (deduped; skipped inside links) |
| `property.has_link` | Any link node |
| `property.has_task_list` | Any GFM task checkbox |
| `property.has_code` | Code block / fenced block / inline code |
| `property.has_incomplete_tasks` | Unchecked task checkbox |
| `property.title` | Plain text of first block-level H1 |

**Response-only (via `GenerateSnippet`):**

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `snippet` | Plain-text summary, max 64 chars, word-boundary truncated |

**Used for lists/previews/filters (frontend):**

- `property.hasLink/hasTaskList/hasCode` → memo filters (`web/src/hooks/useMemoFilters.ts:73-78`)
- `snippet` → relation links, comment previews (`MemoSnippetLink.tsx`, `MemoDetailSidebar.tsx`, `MemoCommentListView.tsx`)
- `tags` → tag search/filter (also content-derived, output-only per proto)

---

### Uncertainties

- **`property.title`**: computed and stored, but no frontend usage found in list/preview components.
- **`ExtractAll` also extracts `@mentions`**, but they are **not** written to `memo.Payload` in current code — only used for notification side effects (`memo_mention_helpers.go:32`).
- **`memopayload.RunOnce`**: batch rebuild utility exists; not called from normal server lifecycle, so old memos would only get fresh metadata via create/content-update or manual invocation.
